title: finding(plugin-charts): `normalizeChartSchema` drops an `xAxis` object's `min` / `max` / `stepSize` / `logarithmic` / `position` unless it also carries `format`, `title` or `showGridLines`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it. The site is `normalizeChartSchema`'s axes block, the x-axis presentation gate: `xAxisSpec.format || xAxisSpec.title || xAxisSpec.showGridLines !== undefined`.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#7690 (PR objectui#10511). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Reproduction (the dev's probe, relayed, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

`normalizeChartSchema({ type: 'chart', chartType: 'scatter', xAxis: { field: 'progress', min: 0, max: 200, stepSize: 50, logarithmic: true, position: 'top' } })` returns `{ chartType: 'scatter', xAxisKey: 'progress' }` with no `xAxis`. The same object plus `title: 'P'` keeps `min` / `max`.

## Reach

- The spec's `ChartAxisSchema` declares `min`, `max`, `stepSize`, `logarithmic` and `position`. PR objectui#10511 declares that object on objectui's `ChartSchema.xAxis`, so after it lands the mirror accepts exactly what this gate then drops.
- Dataset-bound scatter widgets reach it today: `DatasetWidget`'s `axisPresentation` keeps `min` / `max` from a widget's `chartConfig.xAxis`, and the gate then drops them.
- Authored `chart` and `object-chart` nodes reach it too.
- `AdvancedChartImpl`'s scatter `XAxis` (`numericAxisSpecProps`, objectui#9675) never receives the keys.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The shape of the fix: the gate keeps the x-axis object whenever it carries ANY declared presentation key, not three named ones. Pin it per key, with the `title`-carrying case as a control.
- Seam: `spec:ChartAxisSchema.min/max/stepSize/logarithmic/position` → `runtime:normalizeChartSchema` x gate → `renderer:AdvancedChartImpl` scatter `XAxis`.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). `normalizeChartSchema` near `xAxis` / `min` / `max` ⇒ objectui#7690 and PR objectui#10511 (the source) and an unrelated closed locale PR. `scatter` near `min` / `max` / `stepSize` ⇒ closed items on the scatter grid and on refusing an unscalable axis (objectui#9792, #10371, #10388), a different defect. Must-hit control `normalizeChartSchema` ⇒ 6 hits.

Dedupe words: `scatter xAxis min max dropped` · `normalizeChartSchema xAxis gate` · `x axis stepSize logarithmic ignored` · `xAxisSpec title format showGridLines`
